name: Moon G
intro: I made something special for your special day.
birthdayMessage: May your day be filled with happiness, laughter, beautiful memories and everything you deserve.
secretMessage: Life gives us many people, but only a few become truly special.
I'm genuinely grateful for every laugh, every conversation and every memory we've created.
I hope this new chapter of your life brings you endless happiness, success and beautiful surprises.
Stay exactly the way you are. ❤️

memories.caption: One of those moments I'll always remember ❤️
Every memory is a little more special with you 💕
Here's to many more beautiful moments 🥂
